/* background */

a:after{background: #f8f8f8;border: 1px solid #e6e6e6;border-radius: 2px;color: #000000;line-height: 150%;margin-left: 0.5em;margin-right: 3px;padding: 2px 4px;vertical-align: middle;}

/* custom flair */

a[href$="/user/Account"]:after
{ content: "Custom Flair"; }

a[href$="/user/Account"]:after,
a[href$="/user/Account"]:after
{ content: "List flair"; }

/* this is so it doesn't show at the top of the page */

a[title="Profile"]:after,a.upvoatsGiven:after{content:none;}
